title: Splitting Household Chores
paragraphs: After both starting full-time jobs the same month, Rania and her husband realized their old system of dividing housework no longer worked, since neither of them had as much free time as before.

They sat down one evening and made a simple weekly schedule, assigning cooking, cleaning, and grocery shopping fairly between them instead of leaving most tasks to whoever happened to notice them first.
The first two weeks felt slightly awkward, since both of them were used to doing things their own way, and small disagreements came up about how certain tasks should be done properly.

By the third week, the new routine felt far more natural, and Rania noticed they argued about chores much less often than before. Clear expectations, she realized, prevented most unnecessary tension at home.
